tone.summary: Friendly and calm. Describe benefits plainly, do not hype.
tone.source_hype: Voice guide 1.2: Be friendly and calm. Describe the benefit, do not hype it.
tone.source_excl: Voice guide 1.3: Use at most one exclamation mark per post.
tone.source_caps: Voice guide 1.4: Do not write whole words in capitals.

terms.source: Terminology 2.2: The brand name is written as two words, 'Nourish Daily'.

claim_rules.why: Superlative claim with no evidence on file.
claim_rules.source: Claims policy 3.1: Do not use 'best', '#1' or similar unless evidence is on file.
claim_rules.fix: Describe a specific, checkable benefit instead (for example the protein per bar).

claim_rules.why: Absolute guarantee that cannot be supported.
claim_rules.source: Claims policy 3.2: No guarantees or absolute claims.
claim_rules.fix: Remove the guarantee. Say what the product contains, not what it will do for the buyer.

claim_rules.why: Health or weight-loss claim with no approved evidence.
claim_rules.source: Claims policy 3.3 (inspired by ASCI advertising guidance): No unproven health or weight-loss claims.
claim_rules.fix: Remove the claim. Use only nutrition facts from the approved facts list.

facts.label: Protein per bar
facts.text: Each bar has 8 g of protein.

disclosure.source: Disclosure policy 4.1 (inspired by ASCI influencer guidance): Label partnerships clearly with #ad or #sponsored.

samples.name: Sample 1: many issues
samples.text: NourishDaily protein bars are the BEST snack in India!!! Each bar has 12 g of protein and costs just Rs 59. Guaranteed to help you lose weight. Grab yours today, it's cheap! #healthysnacksforyou

samples.name: Sample 2: facts and disclosure
samples.text: Nourish Daily started in 2017 and 9 out of 10 customers say it is the tastiest snack ever. Made with whole oats and no added preservatives. Partnered with @fitwithriya for this launch.

samples.name: Sample 3: clean post
samples.text: Meet the new Nourish Daily oat bar. Each bar has 8 g of protein and costs Rs 49. Made with whole oats and no added preservatives. #NourishDaily

visual.source_palette: Visual guide 5.1: Use the brand palette (greens, off-white and charcoal). Avoid neon or unrelated colours.
visual.source_logo: Visual guide 5.2: Put the Nourish Daily logo on every branded graphic.
visual.source_contrast: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (Contrast, Minimum): text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
